title: Mara and the Language
author: Ansel Halloran
blurb: Ines Iversen, a translator losing a childhood language one borrowed word at a time, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. But when a song on the radio is one that was written and never recorded, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must return to the place where the story went wrong, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
